title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 302 East Green Street in Champaign, Illinois, as the "James R. Burgess Jr. Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 302 East Green Street in Champaign, Illinois, as the "James R. Burgess Jr. Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Champaign, Illinois post office building after James R. Burgess Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 302 East Green Street in Champaign, Illinois, as the "James R. Burgess Jr. Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or how the building is run.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the new name applies from that date.
